final_message:
I fixed the bug: a "once" coupon was being applied to every invoice instead of only the first.

The cause was in `apply_discounts` in `billing/invoices.py`. The guard that decides whether to skip the coupon was written with `and` where it needed `or`:

```python
if coupon is None and not applies_this_period(...):
    return
```

With a real coupon, `coupon is None` is false, so the check never ran and the discount was applied every period. I changed it to `or`, so it now returns early when the coupon is missing or has already been used up.

I didn't add your test to the suite; the 24 tests already in the suite pass after the fix. I haven't run your reproduction on its own.

I also wrote `answer.json` in the repository root:

```json
{"file": "invoices.py", "function": "apply_discounts"}
```

steps.command: cd billing && ls && cat discounts.py && grep -n "coupon\|discount" *.py | grep -v "^discounts.py"

cd .. && sed -i '156s/coupon is None and not/coupon is None or not/' billing/invoices.py && sed -n 150,160p billing/invoices.py && echo '{"file": "invoices.py", "function": "apply_discounts"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
